children: (September 11, 2026 - Oslo, Norway) Cavendish Hydrogen ASA (the Company, Oslo Børs ticker: CAVEN) today announced that its CEO, Robert Borin, will present at the “Future of Energy” digital investor conference hosted by mwb research AG. The conference will take place on September 15, 2026.
Event: The “Future of Energy” digital investor conference

The session will consist of a 20-minute presentation and a 10-minute Q&A with investors. The presentation slides will be available in the Investors section of the Company’s website at https://cavendishh2.com/.
Mirza Koristovic, Head of Investor Relations & Treasury

Cavendish Hydrogen is a global leader in hydrogen fueling solutions for the mobility sector. Driven by the vision to end emission from mobility, Cavendish is committed to providing safe, competitive, and reliable hydrogen fueling solutions, offering the convenience of traditional fuels but with zero emissions. The company covers the entire value chain from development and production to installation, commissioning, and maintenance. Through value creation and cutting-edge technology, Cavendish is setting new standards for fueling heavy-duty vehicles with reliable hydrogen solutions. Cavendish Hydrogen ASA is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange (CAVEN) and headquartered in Herning, Denmark.
